sentences.englishText: Medicine is the science of treating illnesses and injuries.
sentences.turkishText: Tıp, hastalıkları ve yaraları tedavi etme bilimidir.

sentences.englishText: It is very important for our lives.
In the past, people treated illnesses in different ways.
sentences.turkishText: Geçmişte, insanlar hastalıkları farklı yollarla tedavi ediyorlardı.

sentences.englishText: They used plants and animal parts.
Today, modern medicine use the latest technology.
sentences.turkishText: Günümüzde, modern tıp, son teknolojiyi kullanıyor.

sentences.englishText: Doctors find the reasons for the illnesses and treat them.
sentences.turkishText: Doktorlar hastalığın nedenini buluyorlar ve tedavi ediyorlar.

sentences.englishText: X-rays, lasers, test tube babies, MRs (magnetic resonance), CTs (computer tomography) are the miracles of modern medicine.
sentences.turkishText: Röntgen cihazı, lazerler, tüp bebekler, manyetik ses yanıklatma, bilgisayar tomografisi, modern tıbbın mucizeleridir.

enrichment.summary: Medicine is the science of treating illnesses and injuries. It is very important for our lives.
